ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var r = vars.brokerRegistryRaw --- if (r == null) [] else if (r is String) (read(r, "application/json") as Array) default [] else if (r is Array) r else (read(write(r, "application/json"), "application/json") as Array) default []
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- []
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- write(payload, "application/json")

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java import * from dw::core::Strings var b = vars.normalizedBaseUrl default "" --- if (isEmpty(b)) "" else b ++ "/.well-known/agent-card.json"

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json import * from dw::core::Strings fun low(s) = lower(s default "") var desc = trim(error.description default "") var tlsHint = (low(desc) contains "certificate") or (low(desc) contains "hostname") or (low(desc) contains "subject name") or (low(desc) contains "ssl") or (low(desc) contains "tls") or (low(desc) contains "pkix") or (low(desc) contains "handshake") var shortDesc = if (sizeOf(desc) > 450) substring(desc, 0, 450) ++ "…" else desc --- { valid: false, error: if (tlsHint) "HTTPS failed: TLS certificate or hostname does not match this URL. Use the broker base hostname from the agent card (open /.well-known/agent-card.json in a browser and copy the same host as the card \"url\" field)." ++ (if (!isEmpty(shortDesc)) (" Detail: " ++ shortDesc) else "") else "Could not fetch or parse /.well-known/agent-card.json from this base URL." ++ (if (!isEmpty(shortDesc)) (" " ++ shortDesc) else "") }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { valid: false, error: if (isEmpty(vars.incomingBaseUrl default "")) "Missing url. For preview use ?url=https://your-broker.example.com/path/ — include scheme or use a host-only value (https:// is added automatically)." else "Could not build a valid broker URL from input. Check the URL and try again." }

%dw 2.0 output application/json import * from dw::core::Strings var did = (vars.defaultBrokerIdRaw) default "" var didStr = if (did is String) trim(did) else trim(did as String default "") var didOut = if (isEmpty(didStr)) null else didStr --- { brokers: payload map (b) -> { id: b.id, baseUrl: b.baseUrl, alias: b.alias default "", name: b.card.name default "", version: b.card.version default "", description: b.card.description default "", chatUrl: b.chatUrl default "", addedAt: b.addedAt default "", card: b.card }, defaultBrokerId: didOut }
%dw 2.0 output application/json var c = vars.agentCardValidated --- { valid: true, card: c, chatUrl: vars.computedChatUrl }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { valid: false, error: "Missing or empty baseUrl." }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { valid: false, error: "Missing or empty alias. Provide a display name for this broker." }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java import * from dw::core::Strings var list = payload as Array var want = lower(trim(vars.incomingAlias as String)) --- sizeOf((list default []) filter (lower(trim($.alias as String default "")) == want)) > 0

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { valid: false, error: "An agent with this alias already exists. Choose a different agent alias." }

%dw 2.0 output application/json var list = payload as Array var id = "ob_ag_" ++ lower((java!java::util::UUID::randomUUID() as String) replace /-/ with "") var addedAtIso = now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'"} var card = vars.agentCardValidated var entry = { id: id, alias: vars.incomingAlias, baseUrl: vars.normalizedBaseUrl, card: card, chatUrl: vars.computedChatUrl, addedAt: addedAtIso } --- list + entry

%dw 2.0 output application/json var e = vars.newBrokerEntry --- { ok: true, broker: { id: e.id, alias: e.alias, baseUrl: e.baseUrl, name: e.card.name, version: e.card.version, description: e.card.description default "", chatUrl: e.chatUrl, addedAt: e.addedAt } }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { valid: false, error: payload.error default "Invalid or non-A2A agent card." }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var parts = (attributes.requestPath default "") splitBy "/" --- if (sizeOf(parts) > 4) parts[-1] else ""

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload.brokers
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { ok: true, id: vars.brokerIdToDelete }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload

when.expression: #[((vars.defaultBrokerIdRaw as String default '') == (vars.brokerIdToDelete as String)) and not isEmpty((vars.brokerIdToDelete as String) default '')]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java import * from dw::core::Strings var p = payload default {} var raw = if (p is Object) (p.id default p["id"] default null) else null --- if (raw == null) "" else trim(raw as String default "")

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java import * from dw::core::Strings var list = payload as Array var want = trim(vars.defaultPostId as String default "") --- sizeOf((list) filter (trim($.id as String default "") == want)) > 0

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { ok: true, defaultBrokerId: null }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { ok: false, error: "No broker with that id is registered." }

when.expression: #[(attributes.requestPath startsWith '/api/agent/brokers/') and (attributes.requestPath != '/api/agent/brokers/default') and upper(attributes.method as String) == 'DELETE']

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "error": "agent brokers route not found", "path": attributes.requestPath }
